sections.shortTitle: Road Transport Corporation West Pakistan Removal of Undesirable Employees Punjab Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT IV OF 1973
ACT IV OF 1973
ROAD TRANSPORT
CORPORATION (WEST PAKISTAN) REMOVAL OF UNDESIRABLE EMPLOYEES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT)
ACT 1973
An Act to further
amend the Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable
Employees Ordinance, 1965 (West Pakistan Ordinance No. VIII of 1965), in Its
application to the Province of the Punjab
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th February 1973]
(First
published, after having received the assent of the Governor of the Punjab, in
the Gazette of the Punjab (Extraordinary), dated the 26th February 1973).
No. PAP/Legis-2(7)/73/40.---The
Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees
(Punjab Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab on the 10th day of February 1973 and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on the 24th day of February 1973, is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Punjab.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Road Transport Corporation
(West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall extend to the whole
of the Province of the Punjab. (3) It shall come into force at once.

sections.description:
Substitution of Punjab Road Transport Board for Road Transport Corporation and Managing Director for Chairman

ACT IV OF 1973
ACT IV OF 1973
ROAD TRANSPORT
CORPORATION (WEST PAKISTAN) REMOVAL OF UNDESIRABLE EMPLOYEES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT)
ACT 1973
An Act to further
amend the Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable
Employees Ordinance, 1965 (West Pakistan Ordinance No. VIII of 1965), in Its
application to the Province of the Punjab
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th February 1973]
(First
published, after having received the assent of the Governor of the Punjab, in
the Gazette of the Punjab (Extraordinary), dated the 26th February 1973).
No. PAP/Legis-2(7)/73/40.---The
Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees
(Punjab Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab on the 10th day of February 1973 and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on the 24th day of February 1973, is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Punjab.
2. Substitution of Punjab Road
Transport Board for Road Transport Corporation and Managing Director for
Chairman.---In the Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of
Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965 (West Pakistan Ordinance No. VIII of
1965), in its application to the Province of the Punjab, and in any rules
framed thereunder,---
(a) for the words 'Road Transport
Corporation', wherever occurring, the words 'Punjab Road Transport Board' ;
(b) for the word 'Corporation',
wherever occurring the word 'Board' ; and
(c) for the word 'Chairman',
wherever occurring the word 'Managing Director'
shall be substituted.
